name: Personalized Book Lamp
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from a high-quality wood cover, designed to resemble a real book.
    - Built-in LED lighting system provides soft, warm illumination that is gentle on the eyes.
    - The inner pages are crafted from water-resistant and tear-resistant materials, ensuring long-lasting use.
    - Strong magnetic covers allow the lamp to stay securely open in different shapes.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Lamp size: 12 × 17 cm ~ 4.72 × 6.69 in.
    - Compact, lightweight, and easy to carry or display.
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for sharp details and vibrant colors.
    - Features double-sided printing for a polished and premium finish.
     
  • Lighting Options:
    - Features seven-color LED lighting modes, allowing you to switch between different ambient colors.
    - Equipped with a rechargeable battery and supports USB charging for convenient use.
    - Energy-efficient LED ensures low power consumption and long lifespan.
    - Easy to operate with a simple open/close mechanism to turn the light on or off.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a foldable book-shaped lamp that opens up to create a stunning lighting effect.
    - Can be expanded to 180° or 360°, forming various decorative shapes.
    - Magnetic covers keep the lamp stable when fully opened.
    - Suitable for use as a night light, desk lamp, or decorative ambient light.
    - Perfect for placing on bookshelves, bedside tables, desks, or living spaces.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A unique and creative gift for book lovers, friends, and family members.
    - Ideal for birthdays, holidays, housewarming, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Christmas, or special occasions.
    - Combines functionality and artistic design, making it both a practical and decorative item.🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 5 – 7 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Book Lamp

                                          1xUSB charging strip

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

Download templates and mockups here

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
